slides.title: Present perfect continuous
slides.subtitle: Focusing on duration and activity
goals: Talk about activities that have been going on until now.
Explain present evidence: *You look tired. Have you been running?*

slides.title: Form and use

head: Example
rows: I**'ve been waiting** for an hour.

list: Duration up to now: *We've been living here since 2018.*
Recent activity with visible results: *Your eyes are red. Have you been crying?*
slides.tip: Simple = result / how many (*I've written 3 emails*). Continuous = activity / how long (*I've been writing emails all morning*). State verbs (*know, like, have*) stay simple.

items.q: Your hands are dirty! ___ in the garden?

items.t: How long ___ you been learning French?

items.a: How long have you been waiting for the bus?
She's been working here for five years.
